reportedMissing.name: Location issue: Hangman's Hill Haunted Road Cluster: this is not where hangman's hill is
reportedMissing.note:
**Describe the bug**
The "Hangman's Hill Haunted Road Cluster" folklore legend is pinned at 51.6545, 0.0565, which is not where Hangman's Hill is.

**To Reproduce**
1. Open https://www.eppingforestfinds.uk/app#filters and enable the Folklore · Legend places.
2. Find "Hangman's Hill Haunted Road Cluster".
3. Compare its pin with the real Hangman's Hill (https://maps.google.com/?q=51.6545,0.0565 is the reported, wrong, location).

**Expected behavior**
- A single pin at **51.666227, 0.025257**, per https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/hangmans-hill-essex.
- The legend text, name and description stay the same; only the position changes.
- The correction must survive data regeneration and the weekly ledger (cite the Atlas Obscura source wherever the data is produced, so it isn't overwritten).
- Also audit the other folklore/legend pins for wrong positions and report or fix any found.

**Screenshots**
n/a

**Desktop / Smartphone**
 - Safari 26.6.2 on macOS (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)
 - App version: app v62, data v15

**Additional context**
- Reported item: Folklore · Legend — Hangman's Hill Haunted Road Cluster
- Request ID: request-id:adf61353-fb95-4c28-9629-946bc95f65de
- Source for the correct position: https://www.atlasobscura.com/places/hangmans-hill-essex
- This is a data-only fix: it touches `data/**`, so CI bumps `DATA_CACHE_NAME`. The homepage dataset count is unchanged (no pins added or removed).
